D: A young Charles Xavier and Erik Lehnsherr form the first team of mutants during the Cuban Missile Crisis.
P: Serve the snacks when Charles tries his lines on a girl in the Oxford pub.
S: Charles trying his lines in an Oxford pub
A board of aged cheddar, sliced ham, pickled onions, tomato chutney, apple wedges and thick slices of crusty bread with butter.
Erik's visit to the bar in Argentina

Golden baked pastry half-moons filled with cumin-spiced beef, onion, olives and egg, served with a sharp parsley and garlic chimichurri. Brown 500g beef mince with 1 diced onion, 1 tsp cumin and 1 tsp paprika, then add 50g chopped green olives and 1 chopped boiled egg and cool. Cut 12 rounds from 3 shortcrust sheets, fill, fold and crimp the edges. Brush with egg and bake at 200C for 20 minutes. For the chimichurri, mix a chopped bunch of parsley, 2 garlic cloves, 1 tsp chilli flakes, 3 tbsp red wine vinegar and 100ml olive oil.
the standoff off the coast of Cuba
A thick béchamel of butter, flour and milk cooked with chopped ham, chilled overnight, shaped into logs, crumbed and fried until golden.
M: Sebastian Shaw's Hellfire Club in Las Vegas

Rib eye seared hard and butter basted, rested and sliced, with a creamy cracked peppercorn sauce and crispy roast potatoes. Parboil 1kg potato chunks for 8 minutes, shake to rough up and roast in oil at 220C for 45 minutes. Season 2 x 500g rib eyes and sear in a very hot pan for 4 minutes a side, basting with 40g butter for the last minute. Rest 5 minutes. In the same pan, add 1 tbsp crushed peppercorns and 60ml brandy, then 200ml cream and 100ml beef stock, and simmer until thick. Slice and spoon over.
training the young mutants at the Xavier mansion

Whole chicken roasted with lemon and thyme until golden, carved with a mustardy potato salad and buttered green beans for the team. Rub a 1.8kg chicken with butter, salt and thyme, stuff with a halved lemon and roast at 200C for 75 minutes, then rest 10 minutes. Boil 1kg baby potatoes for 15 minutes, halve and toss warm with 3 tbsp mayo, 1 tbsp wholegrain mustard, chives and a squeeze of lemon. Blanch 300g green beans for 3 minutes and toss with butter. Carve the chicken and pour over the pan juices.
W: Dark and white chocolate fudge set in a tray, cut into squares and arranged like a chess board.
K: the spy style of the early sixties

Gin stirred long and cold with a whisper of dry vermouth, strained into frozen glasses with a skewer of green olives. Put 4 martini glasses in the freezer for 30 minutes. Fill a jug with ice, add 240ml gin and 40ml dry vermouth, and stir steadily for 30 seconds until very cold. Strain into the frozen glasses. Add a toothpick with 2 green olives to each. Drink straight away while it is ice cold. For a booze-free version, stir chilled tonic with a splash of olive brine.
